description: Read a support conversation: the messages after "after", oldest first, and who the conversation is waiting on (waitingOn: "us" means Litport, "customer" means you). Replies are not pushed, so poll about every 30 seconds (pollAfterSeconds). Pass the last seq you already have as "after" to get only new messages; leave it out to read from the start. When "more" is true, call again with "after" set to the last seq received.

after.description: The highest message seq you already have.

conversationId.description: Defaults to the conversation started or used most recently in this session.

name: get_support_replies
